This '''unidentified Imperial commander''' was stationed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] returned to Coruscant after crash landing on the desolate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vaal/Legends|Vaal]]. On the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] arrival, he was greeted by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], who expressed his and his superior's concern about Vader's whereabouts. After being ordered to notify the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] about the fact that he had arrived and to send men to retrieve his [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|ship]], the commander noticed that [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|Vader's suit]] had been damaged, revealing a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arm.

Vader quickly covered the damage and without any explanation gave the commander another order to send a new crew to the [[Imperial Relay Outpost V-798|relay station]] on Vaal.
